how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-blackwing-lair-01-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:8288:obj:0: Return the ⟦E1⟧ to ⟦E2⟧ at Cenarion Hold in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:8288:details:0: There is no time to waste! A hero must be found! The task I give will require an army to complete but only one may rise from the throng of would be champions to take on the burden and responsibility of an ally of the Brood.
rows.quest:8288:details:1: Within the lair of the Lord of Blackrock is a most cruel beast. The Broodlord Lashlayer guards the Halls of Strife, blocking the way into ⟦E4⟧'s inner sanctum. Slay the foul aberration and return his head to me. Do this and you may begin the next step of your journey.
rows.quest:8288:progress:0: It is the favor of the Brood of Nozdormu that you must earn.
rows.quest:8288:completion:0: Could you be the first to earn favor among the Bronze Flight in a thousand years?
rows.quest:8730:obj:0: Slay ⟦E4⟧ and recover the ⟦E5⟧. Return the ⟦E5⟧ to ⟦E6⟧ at the Caverns of Time in ⟦E7⟧. You have 5 hours to complete this task.
rows.quest:8730:details:0: Champion, is it you? A thousand years it has been since I was entrusted the shard and it is at my darkest hour that one should rise to relieve me of it... But what would tragedy be without cruelty?
rows.quest:8730:details:2: Ne... Nefarius now holds the scepter shard.
rows.quest:8730:details:3: Time is of the essence. Nefarius plans to destroy the shard. You must hurry!
rows.quest:8730:progress:0: Another of our heroes lost to the spawn of ⟦E8⟧. We will be cursed with this suffering forever...
rows.quest:8730:completion:0: Vaelastrasz's soul is at ease, champion. The Aspects all watch your progress with great interest. Know that you have powerful allies.
rows.quest:8730:completion:1: I was commanded to grant you something to aid you in this struggle. Use it well...
